label: live

steps.assertion: The Pro project terminal opens in its registered dedicated checkout.
The dev-madrid device terminal uses the existing relay and prints the actual remote hostname.
Type or dictate a command and Run send echo hello through the real PTY.
Sticky Ctrl and C interrupt sleep within two seconds and preserve its non-zero exit record.
Reload reconnects the same terminal and replays hello in its scrollback.
The copy buttons include exactly the requested command range and strip every escape code.

screens.expected: a connected project terminal with usable controls and no clipped text

cosmetic: The header path is cut off with an ellipsis ('/Users/ggomes...'), so the full project path isn't visible in the title bar
The shortcut key row is cut off at the right edge: a partial key shows after '→', and any keys after it are only reachable if the row scrolls sideways
Terminal output breaks lines mid-word ('jevellan-l' / 'ive-sandbox', 'jevellan-live-' / 'sandbox %') because the terminal is narrow. This is normal terminal behaviour but harder to read
The big empty terminal area pushes the controls to the bottom. A thin horizontal line near the bottom of the terminal has no clear purpose

screens.expected: a connected dev-madrid terminal with the remote hostname and usable controls

cosmetic: The quick-key row is cut off at the right edge: the last button is only partly visible. The row probably scrolls sideways, but nothing on screen shows that.
A stray 'hostname' line appears above the first prompt, as if the command was echoed before the shell was ready.
A thick horizontal line near the bottom of the terminal area looks like a misplaced cursor or border.

screens.expected: terminal copy and Send to controls reachable at this layout

cosmetic: The host/path subtitle in the header is cut off with an ellipsis ('/Users/ggomes...').
The first key in the special-key row ('→') is partly clipped at the left edge, which suggests the row scrolls sideways but gives no visible hint that it does.
The long shell prompt wraps mid-word ('jevellan-live-' / 'sandbox %'), which makes the terminal output harder to scan.
The 'Copied' status label floats on its own with no clear link to the button that triggered it.

screens.expected: a browser terminal attached to a resumed native coding session, past setup and trust dialogs, with usable exit controls

cosmetic: Terminal footer line 'bypass permissions on (shift+tab to' is cut off at the right edge
The last key in the special-keys row is partly clipped at the right edge, which suggests the row scrolls horizontally
Header subtitle 'dev-madrid scenarios · /home/ggo…' is shortened with an ellipsis
The session's stop hook reports a 'node: not found' error. The UI shows it correctly, but the hook itself is failing.
